newsitem.title: USA: Natl Patent -General Physics merger advances.
newsitem.headline: Natl Patent -General Physics merger advances.

text.p: National Patent Development Corp and General Physics Corp said Friday they had settled litigation that had prevented them from going ahead with plans to merge.
In a joint statement, the companies said they had reached an agreement with a plaintiff who filed a complaint against them in Delaware Chancery Court on September 27.
The plaintiff, a General shareholder, alleged that the companies had breached their fiduciary duty to General's minority shareholders by approving the merger proposal.

Under the agreement with the plaintiff, the companies said they would increase the stock exchange ratio in the merger. Now, each share of General will be exchanged for 0.53 to 0.54 share of National. Previously the ratio was 0.5299.
Also, the "collar" will now be a range of $9.259 to $10, versus $9.336 to $9.914 previously.

National and General said they had scheduled a joint extraordinary meeting of their shareholders for January 23 to vote on the proposal for National to buy 48 percent of General. National already owns a 52 percent stake.
